content.user_title: Create AI Video Plans for Marketing
content.value_statement: Marketing teams need clear video plans before using generation tools. This skill turns campaign ideas into scripts, shot lists, platform notes, and edit guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates hooks, scripts, and outlines for short-form and long-form marketing videos.
Builds scene-by-scene breakdowns with B-roll, overlay text, and transition notes.
Adapts video guidance for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and website embeds.
Suggests thumbnail concepts, title guidance, and call-to-action placement.
Prepares concepts that can be handed to external video generation tools.
limitations: It does not generate or edit video files directly.
It does not verify current social platform algorithm trends.
It depends on the user to provide brand, audience, and offer details.
It does not replace legal, brand, or claims review before publishing.

use_cases.title: Plan Social Video Campaigns
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign idea into short-form concepts with hooks, scripts, captions, and platform notes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Launch Videos
use_cases.description: Create launch scripts, scene plans, thumbnails, and calls to action for product announcements.

use_cases.title: Package Client Video Briefs
use_cases.description: Convert a client goal into a structured production brief for AI video tools or creative teams.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Short Video Concept
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one social video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second vertical video plan for [product] aimed at [audience]. Include the hook, script, B-roll, overlay text, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt One Idea Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this campaign idea for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn. Keep the message consistent, but adjust format, tone, length, captions, and CTA.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Launch Video Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete launch asset plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a video package for launching [offer]. Include one long-form outline, three short-form variants, thumbnail text, title options, transitions, and production notes.

prompt_templates.title: Create an AI Generation Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for external video generation tools.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this marketing brief into a scene-by-scene AI video generation plan. Include visual direction, camera movement, subject actions, text overlays, timing, and edit notes.

output_examples.input: A cleaning software company needs a TikTok concept for facility managers.
output_examples.output: The result would include a three-second pain-point hook, a 30-second script, visual cutaways of work orders, overlay text, and a direct demo CTA.

output_examples.input: A SaaS team wants a YouTube launch video for a new dashboard feature.
output_examples.output: The result would include a two-minute outline, scene timing, product demo beats, thumbnail text, title options, and editing notes for captions.

output_examples.input: An agency needs to brief an AI video tool for a client case study.
output_examples.output: The result would define each scene, subject action, visual style, transition, narration beat, and final CTA for the generation workflow.

best_practices: Provide the audience, offer, platform, desired length, brand tone, and call to action.
Ask for both script and shot list before sending work to a video generation tool.
Review claims, brand rules, and platform requirements before publishing final videos.
anti_patterns: Requesting a video plan without audience, platform, or goal details.
Using one unchanged script across every social platform.
Treating AI video prompts as final production approval without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill generate video files?
faq.answer: No. It creates concepts, scripts, shot lists, and generation briefs for external video tools.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook Reels, and website embeds.

faq.question: Can it help with both short and long videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports short-form videos from 15 to 60 seconds and long-form videos up to 10 minutes.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, goal, platform, brand tone, required length, and call to action.

faq.question: Can it create prompts for VEO or Gemini?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure visual scenes and editing notes for external AI video generation pipelines.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code. Review outputs before publishing marketing claims.
